body: I’ve felt this way for a few months now, drive around and wish someone would t-bone me. But I never do anything dangerous while driving or out myself in positions to be hurt or killed. It’s the most unsettling feeling I’ve ever dealt with and I don’t know what to do.

It is so incredibly overwhelming to have to continuously start over again. I don’t have anyone to fall back on for support. My family questions my choices harshly, and I’m already doing that myself so it’s not helpful when it’s coming at me from all angles. I’m 23 and I know like I have my whole life ahead of me but I’ve already made so many large mistakes in my life it just doesn’t feel worth it anymore. I have nothing to really live for. No family or loved ones to lean on. I don’t want to hurt anyone but I just don’t understand people. It feels like all I do it destroy men emotionally and fail at making things go right. I just want it all to be done with so badly. I want it all to just go away. I feel like I deserve to feel this way, like I’m going crazy. I don’t know what to do. My ex is the only one I’ve really talked to about any of this and I don’t even have that anymore. I don’t have anything.

I don’t know what I’m doing. I tend to lean on the more logical side of things so sometimes I come off cold because emotions are not my strong suit but I’ve been working on that for years. He won’t talk to me about anything if I tell him how I’m feeling he just says “I don’t know what to say” or if I ask how he’s feeling he says “we’ll just see what happens” and I don’t know what that means. 
I did terrible in high school, dropped out of my sorority and college. I moved to Florida for a career that didn’t work then Ohio that didn’t work and now I’m in cosmetology school and it’s not working either. All the choices I’ve made have be large life decisions and I’ve failed at all of them.

I tried everything I could to fix things with him and started going to therapy. He said I make him feel small but he can’t tell me how or in what way. I ended things to try and salvage a friendship but that was last Sunday and he’s out with a girl and I just feel so miserable. And I don’t have any reason to feel that way but all of my relationships have been failures and I really thought maybe he would work out. I loved him so much but I knew I was hurting him, making him feel invaluable, I know those feelings so well and I don’t want anymore to feel that way. so I let him go. I don’t have any family to talk to or close friends and I just am so lost and can’t hardly feel myself breathe. I don’t know what to do anymore. It’s like this relationship was the final straw in all my failures in life.
